## A · Place

Where the offsite happens. Everything else inherits from this.

### A1 · Where should the offsite be held?

**Decides:** Travel budget and how many days the offsite can run.

- [ ] **Our own office** (`office`) — No travel, no booking lead time, and nobody feels away from work.
- [x] **A nearby retreat centre** (`retreat`, recommended) — A change of scene within an hour's drive; needs a booking two months out.
- [ ] **Somewhere abroad** (`abroad`) — Most memorable, most expensive, and it rules out anyone who cannot travel.

**Status:** Decided

### A2 · How is food handled?

**Decides:** Whether catering is booked or improvised.

- [x] **A caterer** (`caterer`, recommended) — One order, one invoice, and dietary needs handled once.
- [ ] **Local restaurants** (`local`) — Cheaper and more flexible; someone has to organise it every day.

**Status:** Decided · harvested → example/offsite#12

> **Note:** Two vegetarians, one nut allergy.

### A3 · Who is invited?

**Decides:** The size of the room and the booking.

- [ ] **Core team only** (`core`) — Only the core team; decisions are faster.
- [x] **Extended team** (`extended`, recommended) — Everyone who works with the team weekly.

**Status:** Decided · changed since harvest → example/offsite#13

> **Note:** Changed my mind after the budget review.

### A4 · Are partners invited to any part of it?

**Decides:** Whether partners or families are part of the plan.

- [ ] **Team only** (`no`, recommended) — A work event, kept as one.
- [ ] **One partner evening** (`evening`) — One evening open to partners; changes the venue requirements.

**Status:** Needs discussion

> **Note:** Worth talking through with the whole team first.
